runtime_proof.harness: The route is exercised through the real HTTP request handler built by createApiServer, with in-memory repositories. No live database is reached and none is claimed — local.env pins SUPABASE_URL to http://127.0.0.1:1 under containment. The change opens no connection, runs no query and alters no repository call, so the behaviour these probes measure is entirely in the request path.

queries.name: an anonymous GET /api/picks/{id}/trace for a seeded pick is refused and leaks nothing
queries.method: handler(new Request(`http://api.local/api/picks/${seededPickId}/trace`)) with no Authorization header, against a runtime seeded with one pick whose metadata carries submittedBy
queries.result: status 401; body.ok === false; body.error.code === 'UNAUTHORIZED'; body.data === undefined; the serialized response contains neither the seeded pick id nor its submittedBy value in any field
queries.significance: This is the exposure. Before the change this exact request returned 200 with the pick's full lifecycle aggregate — record metadata, submission events, promotion history, outbox entries, distribution receipts with delivery targets and external ids, settlement records, audit log entries and lifecycle events.

queries.name: an authenticated operator still receives the unchanged aggregate
queries.method: the same request carrying an operator credential
queries.result: status 200 with all eight payload keys present — pick, submissionEvents, promotionHistory, outboxEntries, distributionReceipts, settlementRecords, auditLogEntries, lifecycleEvents — and the pick id round-tripping
queries.significance: The gate closes the route to anonymous callers without narrowing it for its intended users. The handler and controller are unchanged, so the authenticated response is produced by exactly the code path that produced the unauthenticated one.

queries.name: authentication failure and not-found stay distinguishable
queries.method: an authenticated operator GET for a pick id that does not exist
queries.result: status 404 with error code PICK_NOT_FOUND, not 401
queries.significance: A gate that collapsed 404 into 401 would hide real not-found conditions from operators and make the route undebuggable.

queries.name: the guard is load-bearing — mutation control
queries.method: remove the `|| traceMatch` disjunct from the gate predicate at apps/api/src/server.ts:614 and re-run the suite, then restore the file byte-for-byte
queries.result: not ok 51 — AssertionError: 200 !== 401. # pass 52 / # fail 1. After restoration the guarded suite returns # pass 53 / # fail 0.
queries.significance: The anonymous-401 assertion fails on exactly the condition it names, so it is proving the guard rather than passing alongside it. Only that test is guard-sensitive; the authenticated 200 and 404 correctly pass under the mutation and are not claimed otherwise.
